meta.name: eval-harness
meta.description: Formal evaluation framework for Claude Code sessions implementing eval-driven development (EDD) principles

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并改进Claude Code会话质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Claude Code中系统化评估和提升开发会话质量。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate and improve Claude Code session quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically evaluate and improve development sessions in Claude Code.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照“先定义评估、再实现、最后验证”的流程工作，自动创建评估文件、运行测试并生成报告，帮助衡量任务完成质量。
howto.when: 当你要为 Claude Code 任务设定通过/失败标准、测量可靠性或创建回归测试时触发。

say.text: 请为我的新功能定义评估标准。
say.note: Claude 会创建评估定义文件。

say.text: 运行当前评估并报告状态。
say.note: Claude 会执行评估并显示结果。
Claude 会汇总所有评估结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows a 'define evals first, then implement, then evaluate' workflow, automatically creating eval files, running tests, and generating reports to measure task completion quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to define pass/fail criteria for Claude Code tasks, measure reliability, or create regression tests.

say_en.text: Define evaluation criteria for my new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will create an eval definition file.

say_en.text: Run current evals and report status.
say_en.note: Claude will execute evals and show results.
Claude will summarize all eval results.
